mapper.update: UPDATE task SET updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task} AND current_attempt_id=#{attempt} AND worker_id=#{worker} AND fence=#{fence} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND deadline>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND state='RUNNING'

UPDATE task SET updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task} AND current_attempt_id=#{attempt} AND worker_id=#{worker} AND fence=#{fence} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND deadline>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)<#{retain} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND state='RUNNING'

UPDATE task t JOIN task_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND a.task_id=t.id AND a.id=t.current_attempt_id JOIN model_dispatch d ON d.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND d.task_id=t.id AND d.attempt_id=t.current_attempt_id AND d.id=#{dispatch} SET t.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.id=#{task} AND t.current_attempt_id=#{attempt} AND t.worker_id=#{worker} AND t.fence=#{fence} AND t.lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND a.worker_id=#{worker} AND a.fence=#{fence} AND a.state='ACTIVE' AND a.ended_at IS NULL AND t.state IN ('RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED')

UPDATE task t JOIN task_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND a.task_id=t.id AND a.id=t.current_attempt_id SET t.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.id=#{task} AND t.current_attempt_id=#{attempt} AND t.worker_id=#{worker} AND t.fence=#{fence} AND t.lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND a.worker_id=#{worker} AND a.fence=#{fence} AND ((a.state='STOPPED' AND a.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND t.state=#{state} AND t.state IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED','NEEDS_RECONCILIATION')) OR (#{state}='CANCELLED' AND t.state='CANCEL_REQUESTED' AND a.state='ACTIVE' AND a.ended_at IS NULL))
